provenance.join_rule: fit rows = extractor rows whose (game_id, norm_fen) pair is in TRAIN-only labels, restricted to outer-train ids; expected 791 games / 59892 rows or abort

objective.l2_convention: l2 * ||theta - theta0||^2 SUM from frozen floor theta0

evaluation.holdout_clause: THE HOLDOUT IS NOT READ. NOT ONCE. (abort 2 on any other touch)
